source.title: Result of the WMT Leader Application Period
source.content:
We regret to announce that we could not appoint a Team Leader for the WCA Marketing Team (WMT).

The WCA Board, Leaders, and Senior Delegates could not agree on a suitable applicant for the position so it will not be filled for now.
<!-- break -->
There was only one applicant for the position:
Justin Parera

Justin’s candidacy document can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sdQ-ifmAT34gbWkmsz2qLxkdo51W0j16?usp=sharing) for those interested in viewing it.

Since the WMT has no Leader, the WCA Board will attempt to assume the responsibilities of the WMT Leader until a leader is appointed. We will start a new selection process at an undetermined time in the future.

translation.title: WCA 市场推广团队负责人招募结果
translation.content:
很遗憾，本次未能任命 WCA 市场推广团队（WMT）负责人。

WCA 董事会、各负责人及高级代表未能就合适人选达成一致，因此该职位暂时空缺。

<!-- break -->

本次只有一位申请人：Justin Parera。

Justin 的申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sdQ-ifmAT34gbWkmsz2qLxkdo51W0j16?usp=sharing)查看。

由于 WMT 暂无负责人，WCA 董事会将在新负责人获任命前，尽力承担该岗位的职责。之后会重新启动遴选，具体时间尚未确定。
